headline: Brent Crude Falls Over 6% on Hopes for Iran War Resolution
summary: Brent crude dropped over 6% to $105.55 a barrel, reaching its lowest level in over two weeks amid new hopes of a breakthrough to end the Iran war.
why: Oil is the primary global energy commodity, and significant price fluctuations directly impact inflation, transportation costs, and corporate margins worldwide.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: The input explicitly states that Brent crude dropped by more than 6% to $105.55 a barrel.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Hopes of a breakthrough to end the Iran war eased supply disruption fears, leading to an immediate drop in international oil benchmark prices.
